newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello sees asset price risk overseas.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello sees asset price risk overseas.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday that asset over-valuation in other countries was a risk for the Australian economy.

"The only risk we think worth mentioning in relation to the economic cycle is the international situation, particularly in relation to the possibility of over-valued assets in some of the trading partners," Costello told a financiaL industry conference.
Costello did not name the overseas countries that he was referring to.
The Australian economy has been growing at a moderate to strong pace for five years.
With inflation well within policymakers' targets, the government is forecasting continuing robust growth for the next three or four years, accompanied by continued low inflation.

However, the Australian stockmarket has not risen nearly as far as the U.S. market in recent years and even now it is not far above the level it reached before the October 1987 market crash, in sharp contrast to the Wall Street surge.
Amongst its trading partners, Australia's biggest export market is Japan and its biggest supplier of imports is the United States.
